selectionReason: Documented river floods with four same-orbit calibrated radar acquisitions over focused study corridors. Older Murray/Arkansas events use Sentinel-1 because they predate NISAR. The 2025 Manning flood also uses Sentinel-1 because public NISAR provisional GCOV begins mid-2026. The August 2026 Indiana White River flood uses NISAR provisional GCOV on ascending track 047.

stories.event: Murray River flood around Echuca–Moama, Oct 2022
Arkansas River flood near Dardanelle, May–Jun 2019
NSW Mid North Coast / Manning River record flood at Taree, 20–25 May 2025
stories.whyNotNisar: NISAR provisional public GCOV release covers acquisitions from mid-2026 onward.

stories.event: Indiana White River record flood near Noblesville, mid-August 2026

limits: Radar brightness alone is not a validated flood classification, depth or damage estimate.
Study areas are focused corridors, not statewide disaster extents.
Australia May 2025 uses Sentinel-1 because NISAR provisional GCOV was not yet publicly available for that date.
USA 16 August 2026 is during the documented crest window, not an independent crest-height measurement.
